assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea

Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction

The service is medically necessary to assess for arrhythmias underlying the documented clinical presentation
